youtube_title: Buy Now Pay Later Is Free Money? They're Tricking You #11 #Shorts
youtube_description:
THEY'RE TRICKING YOU #11. 'Buy now, pay later, 0% interest' feels like free money. It isn't: pay later is a loan from a bank or NBFC. Pay on time and it costs nothing extra, but miss the date and you pay a late fee, and the missed payment is reported to the credit bureau, which can pull your credit score down and make future loans or credit cards harder.
Use pay later only when you know you will pay on time.
Source: CRIF High Mark credit bureau (Jan 2025).
Education only, not financial advice.
